lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Zn4O6 (YZn2O3) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Zn centers with four O neighbors (1.935–2.203 Å) and Y centers in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors (2.337–2.468 Å). Corner-sharing between O-centered octahedra and edge-sharing between Y-centered octahedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
